## Interactions & Behaviors

### Smart List Selection (left rail)
- Clicking a smart list in the left rail navigates to `/people/list/<id>` and loads that list's contacts into the main table
- The selected item gets a blue background highlight and white text
- [INFERRED] Hovering a left rail item reveals a quick-action or context menu icon

### Row Selection / Checkboxes
- Individual row checkboxes toggle that row's selected state
- Header checkbox: checked = select all visible, unchecked = deselect all, indeterminate dash = some selected
- "Deselect all" text link resets all selections instantly
- Selecting one or more rows causes the bulk action bar to appear above the table [INFERRED it slides in]

### Bulk Action — Tag Dropdown
- Clicking the tag icon in the bulk action bar opens a small dropdown menu with two options:
  - "Add Tags" — opens a tag picker/input to add tags to all selected contacts
  - "Remove Tags" — opens a tag picker/input to remove tags from all selected contacts
- [INFERRED] Selecting "Add Tags" opens a modal or inline tag-search input

### Bulk Action — Delete/Archive
- Clicking the archive/trash icon in the bulk action bar triggers a confirmation dialog before archiving all selected contacts [INFERRED]

### Filter Panel
- Clicking "Filters (4)" button toggles the filter panel open/closed (slides in from right side)
- Each filter chip's down-caret opens an inline editor for that filter condition
- "Clear filters" removes all filter conditions at once and reloads the unfiltered list
- "Add a filter" at the top of the panel opens a filter builder (field selector → operator → value)
- [INFERRED] Filter changes auto-apply or require clicking an "Apply" button

### "Update List" Button
- Saves the current filter set as the smart list definition
- This makes the smart list dynamic: any new contacts matching the filters will appear automatically
- [INFERRED] The button becomes active/enabled only when filters have been changed from the saved state

### "Columns" Dropdown
- Opens a column picker to show/hide table columns
- [INFERRED] Current visible columns: Name, [score/tags], Last Visit, Phone, Email, Last Activity

### "Out Of State Home…" Dropdown
- Appears to be a saved view or grouping toggle (e.g., grouping contacts by "Out of State Home" criteria)
- [INFERRED] Clicking opens a list of available views/groupings

### "How Smart Lists work" Link

## Data Model Signals

### Entities Revealed

**Person / Contact:**
- `id` (integer, part of URL path)
- `name` (string; full name displayed, also used to generate 2-letter avatar initials)
- `company` (string; "Z8 Villa LLC" suggests contacts can be business entities)
- `source` (enum: "Import", "Report", "Expired Listing", "Farm", and likely many others)

- `email` (string; standard email format)
- `last_visit` (datetime; displayed as "Nov 13th 'YY" format)
- `last_activity` (string/fk; shows most recent activity summary)
- `tags` (array of strings; filterable, addable/removable in bulk)
- `stage` (enum/string; filterable; possible values include things like "Real Estate" stage visible in filter)

- `Real Est…` (likely a stage name like "Real Estate Lead" or "Real Estate Inquiry")

**Activity / Last Activity:**
- `type` (enum; "Inquiry" visible — likely also: Email, Call, SMS, Note, Stage Change, etc.)
- `address` (string; the property address associated with the inquiry)
- `timestamp` (datetime; formatted as "Nov 13th 'YY")

**Phone Communication Channels:**
- WhatsApp availability flag (boolean; green icon = WhatsApp-enabled number)
- Voice/call availability flag (boolean; blue phone icon = callable)

### Relationships
- Person (many) ↔ Tags (many): many-to-many
- Person (many) → Stage (one): many-to-one
- Person (many) → SmartList (many): many-to-many (via filter matching)
- SmartList (one) → FilterConditions (many): one-to-many
- Person (one) → LastActivity (one): one-to-one (latest activity pointer)
- Person (many) → Activities (many): one-to-many

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **Smart list count badge vs actual filter count:** The left rail badge (13) reflects the number of contacts currently matching all 4 active filters for this smart list — this is a denormalized/cached count that updates when the list is refreshed or contacts change.

2. **"Update List" button:** A smart list in FUB is stored as a set of filter conditions. When a user changes the filters in the filter panel, those changes are live but not yet saved to the smart list definition. "Update List" commits the current filter state as the new definition, making the smart list dynamic going forward. This is a key UX distinction from a static saved search.

3. **Bulk selection across pages:** [INFERRED] FUB may only select visible rows; selecting all 13 in a 13-contact list via "Deselect all" inversion pattern would need careful implementation if list spans multiple pages.

4. **Tag dropdown as a two-step flow:** Clicking the tag icon opens the Add/Remove submenu; selecting "Add Tags" then opens a tag autocomplete/search input (likely in a modal or inline typeahead) where the user types to find and apply tags.

5. **Avatar color assignment:** Colors appear to be deterministically assigned from a palette based on contact name or ID (not random on each render), so the same contact always shows the same color.

6. **Source label rendering:** The source ("Import", "Report", "Expired Listing", "Farm") is rendered as a secondary line below the contact name in the Name cell — it is not a separate column, but inline formatting within the Name column.

7. **Phone cell multi-icon pattern:** The phone cell shows a WhatsApp icon and a phone icon as action triggers adjacent to the number. These are clickable communication shortcuts — clicking WhatsApp opens SMS compose in that channel, clicking phone opens the FUB dialer. The presence of each icon indicates that the contact's number has been verified or opted-in to that channel.

8. **"NEIGHBORHOOD(S)" badge:** The page subtitle badge "13 NEIGHBORHOOD(S)" does not mean there are 13 neighborhoods — it indicates this is a neighborhood-type smart list and that there are 13 contacts matching it. This badge type/label likely varies by smart list category (e.g., "PIPELINE" for pipeline lists).

9. **Filter truncation:** Filter chip labels are truncated with "…" due to panel width. Full values are revealed when the chip's down-caret is clicked to expand/edit the filter.

10. **"Out Of State Home…" dropdown:** This appears to be a column group or saved column set selector, not a filter. It may allow switching between different column layouts (e.g., "Out of State Home" columns vs. standard columns) — a FUB feature for customizing which data attributes are displayed per list context.

11. **Horizontal scroll:** The table has more columns than can be shown in the viewport (especially when the filter panel is open). The horizontal scrollbar confirms this — additional columns are accessible by scrolling right. Typical additional FUB columns include: Assigned Agent, Price Range, Buying Time Frame, Lead Score, Last Note, etc.

12. **All contacts show same Last Visit date (Nov 13th '25):** This is a data signal suggesting these contacts were all imported or had a bulk action performed on that date, OR that the "Last Visit" column tracks when the contact last visited the website and all visited on that same day due to a campaign or tracking pixel event.
